proof_body:
by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro F hF h0
    have hconst := is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero (f := F 0) (fun x => (hF 0 x).differentiableAt)
      (fun x => by rw [(hF 0 x).deriv]; exact h0 x)
    exact ⟨fun _ => F 0 0, fun x => by simp [hconst x 0]⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    intro F hF h0
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := ih (fun k => F (k + 1)) (fun k x => hF (k + 1) x) h0
    let P : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c k / ((k : ℝ) + 1) * x ^ (k + 1)
    have hP : ∀ x, HasDerivAt P (F 1 x) x := by
      intro x
      have : F 1 x = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c k / ((k : ℝ) + 1) * (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * x ^ k) := by
        rw [hc x]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
        have : ((k : ℝ) + 1) ≠ 0 := by positivity
        push_cast
        field_simp
      rw [this]
      refine HasDerivAt.fun_sum fun k _ => ?_
      exact ((hasDerivAt_pow (k + 1) x).const_mul _)
    have hd : ∀ x, HasDerivAt (fun x => F 0 x - P x) (F 1 x - F 1 x) x := fun x =>
      (hF 0 x).fun_sub (hP x)
    have hconst := is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero (f := fun x => F 0 x - P x)
      (fun x => (hd x).differentiableAt)
      (fun x => by rw [(hd x).deriv]; ring)
    refine ⟨fun k => if k = 0 then F 0 0 - P 0 else c (k - 1) / (k : ℝ), fun x => ?_⟩
    have e : F 0 x - P x = F 0 0 - P 0 := hconst x 0
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ']
    have : F 0 x = P x + (F 0 0 - P 0) := by linarith
    rw [this]
    simp [P]
target_source: ∀ (n : ℕ) (F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ), (∀ k x, HasDerivAt (F k) (F (k + 1) x) x) → (∀ x, F (n + 1) x = 0) → ∃ c : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ x, F 0 x = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c k * x ^ k
